name: Nadcranntail
text: Nadcranntail, also written Natchrantel, is a champion of Connacht serving Queen Medb in the Táin Bó Cuailnge. He leads a third of the army on a bold raid into Ulster, comes upon the Brown Bull in Antrim, and drives both bull and herd back toward home. He will not fight Cúchulainn, judging him a beardless boy. Cúchulainn answers with a false beard and cuts him down at speed.

key_results: Nadcranntail serves Queen Medb as a Connacht champion in the Táin.
He raids Ulster and drives the Brown Bull and its herd home.
Cúchulainn dons a false beard to meet him and kills him quickly.
